comments.author: Bean0
comments.body: This is neat, any insight into process?

replies.author: Decision0
replies.body: I built it with TypeScript and PixiJS, using a deterministic battle simulation I didn't use any sprites. Fighters are mostly data-driven, with reusable weapons, abilities, AI behaviors, etc. This wasn’t a one-shot prompt. I built it through a lot of iterations, adding one system at a time, testing it.
